title: NORTHCOM: jellyfish UAP crosses US-Mexico border

tellings.quote: >> jellyfish UAP crosses US Mexico border.

plain: A floating thing shaped like a jellyfish crossed the border from Mexico into the United States, according to a case Michels reads out on his show with Matthew Brown, a former Defense Department official who says he wrote the Immaculate Constellation report, an unsigned paper entered into the record of a congressional hearing on 13 November 2024 that the Defense Department says matches no program it knows of. The report says government networks hold infrared camera footage of "an irregularly shaped UAP flying across the southern border", UAP being the government's term for unidentified objects, that "approximated a jellyfish or floating 'brain' with hanging appendages", which if true would mean such a thing was filmed entering the country. The report gives this as its own account and describes the footage in words without any image.

discussion.by: Immaculate Constellation report (anonymous, entered into the House Oversight hearing record, 13 November 2024)
discussion.text: An unsigned report that Michael Shellenberger delivered to Congress and Rep. Nancy Mace entered into the record of the House Oversight hearing of 13 November 2024 as a document from the Pentagon; it calls itself the public version of a Defense Department employee's report, cleared for release by the State Department; Matthew Brown, a former Defense Department official, later said he wrote it; and a Defense Department spokesperson said the department has no record of a program by that name. The report's case "NORTHCOM Jellyfish UAP Crosses US-Mexico Border" says that on government networks there is FLIR footage of "an irregularly shaped UAP flying across the southern border" that "approximated a jellyfish or floating 'brain' with hanging appendages". Jesse Michels reads out the case's heading, so the story is the report's own account; the report describes the footage in words and holds no image of it.
